Let's abbreviate $(\lambd[ux][x(uux)])$ by~$U$, so that $Y \ident UU$. Then
  \begin{align*}
    Y g &\ident (\lambd[ux][x(uux)])U\,g \\
    &\red (\lambd[x][x(UUx)])g\\
    & \red g(UUg) \ident g(Yg).
  \end{align*}
  Since $g(Yg)$ and $Yg$ both reduce to $g(Yg)$, $g(Yg) \equal[\beta]
  Yg$, so $Yg$ is a fixpoint of~$g$.
